scientific_integrity: The all-size statements are proved by explicit integer incidence congruence and cyclic-gap enumeration. Exact finite tests are supporting checks only.
scientific_limitations: The matrix tests consistency of the union of positive adjacency requirements of two complete one-types over an induced cycle; it is not pairwise adjacent-realization feasibility. No statement for arbitrary parameter graphs or higher tuple compatibility is claimed. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Exact integral join-compatibility spectra for one-types over cycles in the triangle-free homogeneous graph
